scripts.dev: bun run --filter frontend dev & bun run --filter backend dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter frontend build && bun run --filter backend build
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run --filter backend deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build && bun run --filter backend deploy:staging
scripts.deploy:production: bun run build && bun run --filter backend deploy:production
